decision.explanation: The question asks when 'the Church of Our Lady of the Rosary' was built. However, the phrase 'the Church of Our Lady of the Rosary' refers to multiple distinct churches across different locations (Alcamo, Goa, Asmara, and San Bernardino). Each of these churches has its own construction date, as documented in the provided sources. The dates 1660, 1750, 1544–1547, 1923, and 1928 correspond to different instances of the same name in different geographic contexts. Since the question does not specify a location, all valid referents and their corresponding construction dates are preserved.
